CreateFlowAlias.description_en: Creates an alias for a flow. You can specify the alias when initiating an execution
CreateFlowAlias.description_zh: 为流程创建别名，此后可以在发起执行时指定流程别名

DeleteFlow.description_zh: 删除一个已存在的流程

DescribeExecution.description_en: Retrieves the status information of an execution. This operation supports long polling, where the maximum wait time is specified by the WaitTimeSeconds parameter
DescribeExecution.description_zh: 获取一次执行的状态信息，支持长轮询模式，长轮询最长等待时间由 WaitTimeSeconds 参数指定

DescribeFlow.description_en: Retrieves the details of a flow
DescribeFlow.description_zh: 获取一个流程的相关信息

DescribeFlowAlias.description_en: Queries the details of a flow version alias
DescribeFlowAlias.description_zh: 查询流程版本别名详情

DescribeMapRun.description_en: Queries the details of a MapRun

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions supported by CloudFlow
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询云工作流产品支持的地域信息

DescribeSchedule.description_en: Queries the detailed information about a time-based schedule
DescribeSchedule.description_zh: 获取一个定时调度信息

GetExecutionHistory.description_en: Queries the details about each step in an execution process
GetExecutionHistory.description_zh: 获取指定执行过程中的每个步骤详细信息

ListExecutions.description_en: Retrieves all historical executions of a flow
ListExecutions.description_zh: 获取一个流程的所有历史执行

ListFlowAliases.description_zh: 查询流程版本别名列表

ListSchedules.description_en: Queries time-based schedules in a flow

PublishFlowVersion.description_en: Publishes a new flow version based on the current workflow definition, with the version number incrementing from 1. The flow version includes the workflow definition, description, environment variable settings, and execution role definition
PublishFlowVersion.description_zh: 以当前工作流的定义发布新的流程版本，版本号从1递增，流程版本会包含工作流定义、描述、环境变量设置和执行角色定义信息

ReportTaskFailed.description_zh: 汇报指定的任务执行失败

ReportTaskSucceeded.description_zh: 汇报指定的任务执行成功

StartSyncExecution.description_en: Starts the execution of a flow through a synchronization call
StartSyncExecution.description_zh: 同步调用开始一个流程的执行

StopExecution.description_zh: 停止一个正在执行的流程

UpdateFlow.description_en: Updates the content of a flow

UpdateFlowAlias.description_en: Updates the alias configuration of a flow version
UpdateFlowAlias.description_zh: 更新流程版本别名配置

UpdateMapRun.description_en: Updates the configuration of a MapRun
